title: WOW Task File
description: YAML Actions Based Automation (WOW) task file — a list of task objects.

pool.description: Endpoint pool — one or more equipment groups providing connection targets.

actions.description: Top-level action list for this task.

Variables.description: Key-value variable map. Values may be strings, numbers, booleans, lists, or dicts. String values support ${var} substitution.

PoolEntry.description: One equipment group in the pool. Duplicate group names merge their endpoint lists (spec and ignores must match).

group.description: Group name referenced by 'endpoint:' in actions.

variables.description: Group-level variables substituted into endpoint definitions at pool-build time.

endpoints.description: List of endpoint objects in this group.

ignores.description: Endpoint names to exclude from this group entirely.

Spec.description: Validates endpoint structure and controls which fields become vertical variables.

required.description: Map of required endpoint field names to their allowed value constraint: a regex string or an explicit list of allowed strings. 'name' is always required implicitly.

oneOf.description: Regex pattern the field value must fully match.

excludes.description: Fields excluded from vertical variable lists. Still accessible as path variables: ${name.field} or ${name.field.subfield}.

major-key.description: The required field used as the secondary grouping key (defaults to the first required field other than 'name').

Endpoint.description: An endpoint (device or host). 'name' is required. 'viae' provides connection back-ends. All other fields become endpoint variables.

name.description: Unique endpoint name within its group. Must match the 'name' regex in spec.

viae.description: Connection back-ends keyed by via name (e.g. 'ssh', 'http', 'serial', 'native', 'namespace'). Values are transport-specific parameter objects.

ViaConfig.description: Per-transport connection parameters. All fields are transport-specific; 'nolock' is supported by all transports.

nolock.description: Disable connection locking for this via.

ActionItem.description: One entry in an actions list. A bare string is a shorthand shell command. A dict is a full action node, direct-feed node, or auto node. A '<yamllist>: path' directive splices an external list file.

oneOf.description: Shorthand: executed as a shell command on the active via.

ActionNode.description: A structured action node. One payload key (actions/commands/files/http-actions/snippets) or a direct-feed key (command/text/…/http-action/file/snippet) must be present. Auto nodes use 'auto' in place of 'action'.

action.description: Display label shown as a section header. Set to null to suppress the header.

enabled.description: Whether this node is active. Boolean or a Python expression string.

parallel.description: Run child actions concurrently in separate threads. Boolean or a Python expression string.

vertical.description: Split tmux panes vertically (true) or horizontally (false) when parallel is enabled.

percent.description: Tmux pane size as a percentage when parallel is enabled.

quite.description: Suppress all output from this action and its children.

verbose.description: Emit extra diagnostics: via name, status codes, pipe/filter flow.

check.description: Propagate exit-status failures to parent action status. Boolean or Python expression.

indent.description: Indent child output under this action's header.

stop-on-fail.description: Stop the remaining sibling actions if this action fails.

stoppable.description: Allow a soft-stop (first SIGINT) to break out of this action.

endpoint.description: Endpoint name to target. Overrides the endpoint inherited from the parent.

via.description: Via selector. A string picks one via by name; a list tries each in order (first available wins); a dict creates an anonymous inline via: {ViaType: {params}}.

http-params.description: Default HTTP parameters inherited by all http-actions in this subtree.

stream.description: Name for this action's output stream (default: 's<index>').

.on-stop.description: Action node to run when a soft-stop is triggered while this action is running. Must be a full action dict (not a direct feed or list).

variables.description: Local variables scoped to this node and its siblings (resolved in a second pass after auto expansion).

commands.description: List of command-feed items executed sequentially on the active via.

auto.description: Auto-node type. Generates one expanded copy of 'template' per row from the data source.

template.description: Template action(s) expanded for each auto-node row. A single dict or a list of dicts.

prefix.description: Prefix for loop variables exposed to the template: ${prefix.index}, ${prefix.value}, ${prefix.count}, etc.

index.description: Starting value for the loop index variable (default 1).

range.description: For 'auto: range' — range spec passed to Python range(). A single number N gives range(N); a list [stop], [start, stop], or [start, stop, step] mirrors Python's range() signature.

args.description: For 'auto: args' — list of argument definitions. Each item maps a variable name to a comma-separated list of values. Special wrapper keys 'permutation' and 'union' group multiple variables.

x2args.description: For 'auto: args' — second-expansion argument nodes. Each item is substituted after the first 'args' expansion, allowing derived variables.

delimiter.description: For 'auto: args' — delimiter used when splitting arg value strings (default ',').

data.csv.description: For 'auto: data' — path to a CSV data file.

data.yaml.description: For 'auto: data' — path to a YAML data file.

range.ie.description: For 'auto: data' — like 'range' but filters out empty rows before index selection.

filter.description: For 'auto: data' — Python filter expression evaluated per data row. {} is the row dict; {.index} is the row index. Use [: key :] as dict-key shorthand.

filter.range.description: For 'auto: data' — range applied to post-filter rows.

filter.var.description: For 'auto: data' — variable name whose value is used as the filter expression.

command.description: Direct-feed shorthand: a shell command. Promotes this dict into a commands action.

text.description: Direct-feed shorthand: emits the value as a literal string stream.

etext.description: Direct-feed shorthand: emits repr() of the value.

int.description: Direct-feed shorthand: emits int(value). Append base as modifier, e.g. 'int.16' for hex.

json.description: Direct-feed shorthand: emits the value serialised as JSON. Append indent as modifier, e.g. 'json.2'.

import.description: Direct-feed shorthand: reads the named Exports key into the stream.

getstream.description: Direct-feed shorthand: reads the named stream into the stream.

http-action.description: Direct-feed shorthand: a single HTTP request. Promotes this dict into an http-actions action.

file.description: Direct-feed shorthand: a single file operation. Promotes this dict into a files action.

snippet.description: Direct-feed shorthand: a Python snippet. Value is either a path to a .py file or an inline snippet dict with 'code:'.

Repeat.description: Repeat settings for an action. Keys starting with '.' are control parameters. Any other keys are written into Exports on every iteration and accessible via +{key}.

.count.description: Maximum iteration count. Omit or use a large number for indefinite repetition.

.until.description: Stop-condition Python expression evaluated after each iteration. Stops when truthy.

.strategy.description: 'normal': next iteration starts immediately if the previous overran. 'strict': waits for the remainder of the current interval slot before starting the next.

.check.description: Propagate each iteration's exit status to the parent action.

.log.description: Accumulate output from all iterations (true) or keep only the last iteration's output (false).

.stoppable.description: Allow a soft-stop (SIGINT) to break out of the repeat loop.

.prefix.description: Prefix for Exports loop-counter keys. Exposes +{<prefix>.index} and +{<prefix>.count}.

.index.description: Starting value for the loop index (default 1).

CommandItem.description: One entry in a 'commands:' list. A plain string is a shell command. A dict has exactly one feed key plus optional modifiers.

CommandNode.description: A structured command-feed dict. Exactly one feed key must be present. The key may carry a dot-suffix modifier, e.g. 'int.16' or 'json.2'.

command.description: Shell command executed on the active via.

text.description: Emit the value as a literal string.

etext.description: Emit repr() of the value (escaped string).

bool.description: Emit bool(value) as a Python bool.

int.description: Emit int(value[, base]). Append base as modifier: 'int.16' for hex.

json.description: Emit the value serialised as JSON. Append indent as modifier: 'json.2'.

eval.description: Evaluate a Python expression and emit the result.

import.description: Read an Exports key and emit its value.

getstream.description: Read a named stream and emit its value.

export.description: Exports key under which to store the command output. Also exposes '<key>.stderr' and '<key>.status'.

stoppable.description: Allow soft-stop during execution of this command.

rw_retries.description: Number of read/write retries before failing (SSH via).

stream.description: Output stream name for this command (default: 'cs<index>').

FileItem.description: A file-transfer or file-system operation on the active via.

path.description: Path on the target. Used by 'remove', 'mkdir', 'rmdir', 'chmod', 'upgrade'.

mode.description: File mode as an octal integer. Used by 'chmod'.

check.version.description: Command that reports the current installed version. Used by 'upgrade'. Exit 0 = needs upgrade.

on.up-to-date.description: Command to run when already up-to-date. Used by 'upgrade'.

on.success.description: Command to run after a successful upgrade.

on.fail.description: Command to run after a failed upgrade.

HttpActionItem.description: One HTTP request. Items in 'http-actions:' are this object directly. As a direct feed the same structure is the value of 'http-action:'.

path.description: URL path (relative to the via's base address).

always-login.description: Force a fresh login before every request.

auth.description: Authentication parameters passed to the via.

retries.description: Number of retry attempts on failure.

args.description: Request parameters passed as keyword arguments to via.request(). Append '.json' to a key to serialise its value as JSON before sending.

stream.description: Output stream name for this request's response (default: 'hs<index>').

SnippetItem.description: A Python snippet item in a 'snippets:' list.

code.description: Inline Python code or path to a .py file. The script must define a 'wowmain' function.

stream.description: Output stream name for this snippet's result (default: 'ss<index>').

FilterList.description: Ordered list of filter operations applied to the stream in sequence.

FilterItem.description: One filter step. A string names a filter method ('ClassName.method' or a Python builtin). A dict is either a filter call with arguments or an if/elif/else conditional block.

oneOf.description: Filter method name: 'ClassName.method' (e.g. 'TextFilter.merge') or a Python builtin (e.g. 'str'). Applied to the current stream with no arguments.
Filter call with arguments, or an if/elif/else conditional. For a call: the key is 'ClassName.method' and the value is the argument(s). For a conditional: keys are 'if', 'elif', 'elif.N', 'else'.

FilterBranch.description: A conditional filter branch (if / elif). 'condition' is a Python expression where {} stands for the current stream value.

condition.description: Python expression. {} is replaced with the current stream value. Branch executes if the expression is truthy.

FilterElseBranch.description: The else branch of a conditional filter — no condition, always executes if no preceding if/elif matched.

FilterCallArgs.description: Arguments to a filter method call. A scalar or list is passed as positional args. A dict may use '.args' (list) and '.kwargs' (object) to pass both.

PipeList.description: List of pipe definitions that route and transform streams.

PipeItem.description: A single pipe: reads from 'sources', applies 'filters', and writes to 'stream'. Nested 'pipes' chain further transformations on the output stream.

stream.description: Output stream name. Use '*' for pass-through mode (copies sources to their original names unchanged; filters and nested pipes are not allowed).

PipeSources.description: Input stream(s) for a pipe. A string names one stream (or '*' for all). A list names multiple streams explicitly. A dict selects streams dynamically by name pattern.

oneOf.description: Single stream name, or '*' to select all available streams.
Dynamic stream selection by name pattern. Exactly one of the selector keys must be present.

startswith.description: Select streams whose names start with this string.

endswith.description: Select streams whose names end with this string.

contains.description: Select streams whose names contain this string.

regex.description: Select streams whose names match this regex (re.search, so prefix-anchoring with ^ is available).

range.description: Generate stream names from 'template' for indices in this range. A list [stop] or [start, stop, step].

template.description: Stream name template used with 'range'. Supports ${sources.value}, ${sources.index}, ${sources.count}, etc.
